notes.title: IGNISTONE Soundtrack is getting released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing IGNISTONE!

It has been about a month and a half since the release, and we are happy that so many of you have played and enjoyed the game.

We are excited to announce that IGNISTONE Soundtrack will be released on Steam.
The soundtrack include a total of 19 songs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/3d380a1607da189afd5c5f5288185bdbc1cfd3f2.png[/img]

The release is scheduled for later this year, so please stay tuned and look forward to it!

notes.title: Ver 2.1.1
notes.notes:
・We have fixed a bug where if you press "END" immediately after leveling up the amulet would cause the display to glitch.

notes.title: We will be participating in Tokyo Indies!
notes.notes:
Thank you for visiting the IGNISTONE store page.

We are excited to announce that we will be participating in Tokyo Indies, which will be held on October 18th in Tokyo. There will be a pitch about IGNISTONE, so if you live in the Tokyo area, please come and join us.

Tokyo Indies is a casual gathering that takes place in Akihabara, Tokyo, once a month. It's where indie game developers come together to showcase their games, exchange ideas, and enjoy a relaxed evening. About half of the participants are from overseas, so even if you don't speak Japanese, it's okay. Please feel free to join us.

For more information about Tokyo Indies, please check here:
You will need an age-verification ID when entering.
[url=https://www.tokyoindies.com/en/]https://www.tokyoindies.com/en/[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/tokyo_indies]https://twitter.com/tokyo_indies[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/f016c550a6319143241b20acbc197e3efe780050.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ver 2.1
notes.notes:
・You can now move in the village using the A and D keys.
・We have fixed a bug where the effects of the fortune-telling choices would persist until the next exploration.
・We have fixed a bug where right-clicking immediately after opening the outfit shop would cause the display to glitch.
・We have fixed a bug where pressing the × button the moment you open the amulet exchange would cause the display to glitch.
・We have fixed an issue where the text would be cut off when you have a certain number of berries.

notes.title: Ver 2.0
notes.notes: ・We have changed the difficulty display of the "Chaotic Road" from 4 to 5.

notes.title: Ver. 1.9
notes.notes:
・We have fixed the issue with the Steam achievement "Ultimate Challenge 8".
・We have fixed the issue where the ESC key does not work in the tutorial.
・We have made it so that the announcement for not using the amulet robot will be displayed only once.

notes.title: Ver 1.8
notes.notes:
・We have fixed a minor issue related to the appearance of the Fortune Telling Mame.
・We have fixed a minor issue that the effects of amulets become unviewable when the list of activated amulets is hidden behind the dialogue window.
・We have fixed some dialogue bugs for the Simplified Chinese version.

notes.title: Ver 1.7
notes.notes: We have fixed the bug where the player freezes when you use your special attack during the first attack after a parry.

notes.title: Ver. 1.6
notes.notes:
・Now when you press the Esc key, you can choose whether to exit the game.
・We have corrected some typos.

notes.title: Ver. 1.5
notes.notes:
・We have made it so that the game continues running even when the window is not active.
・We have corrected typos.

notes.title: Ver 1.4
notes.notes: Adjusted the difficulty of Cave Of Time.

notes.title: Ver 1.3
notes.notes: We have implemented a feature that allows you to return to the village after saving in the dungeon.

notes.title: IGNISTONE has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/c71291200521879c3e6236d4ba8854103513ab53.jpg[/img]

IGNISTONE has been released!

To create a simple yet exciting roguelike action game that focuses on parry, we gave it our all for two years.

Unique and cute characters, intense battles, various equipments, many mini-games, and high difficulty dungeons that put your skills to the test - we've put our heart into creating each element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/e12e86f187cdf7f270af2f94b01372b6b81f44fc.jpg[/img]

We want to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who attended our events, followed us on social media, and supported us in a big way. Thank you very much.

Now, please enjoy the playful world of IGNISTONE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/b77ac6bc5c67fe9e77377f3dfc2f87735fec57b0.png[/img]

[b]A Request to Everyone[/b]
If you encounter any issues or problems related to the game, we would greatly appreciate it if you could report them in this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2393890/discussions/0/3884974596970899141/

You can also report them to this email address:
mono2568gcl@gmail.com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/2350263b80708028f21b19b541f4d624e457a7da.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank You for Visiting Tokyo Game Show!
notes.notes:
Thank you for visiting the IGNISTONE steam page!

IGNISTONE was exhibited at Tokyo Game Show, held from September 21st to 24th, 2023. To everyone who came to the IGNISTONE booth, we sincerely thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/ed7a30f8eaa9ac9ac5ebabd5cd4ce6016f972865.jpg[/img]

IGNISTONE is finally releasing next week on October 3rd.

We've put our hearts into creating an exciting rogue-like action game that focuses on parry.

We hope you enjoy the playful world of IGNISTONE!

notes.title: We will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2023!
notes.notes:
Thank you for visiting the IGNISTONE Steam page. We're now just under a month away from the release!

Now, we have an announcement for our final event before the release. IGNISTONE will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show, which will take place at Makuhari Messe from September 21st to 24th.

IGNISTONE will be showcased at the booth of Kodansha Game Creators Lab.
During Tokyo Game Show, game developer mono and representatives from Creators Lab will be present at the booth, so please come and meet us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/ed64d2946cac4b9a7517a99fe7d333a221920f2a.jpg[/img]

The photo shows the booth from last year's Tokyo Game Show. This year, we have prepared an upgraded booth for you to enjoy!

notes.title: IGNISTONE demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
Thank you for reading the news page.
While IGNISTONE is scheduled for release on October 3rd, we are excited to announce the release of the demo version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978167/175789d265409a038b5012db06167b9803140e33.jpg[/img]

In the demo, you'll be able to play through the beginning of the game.
After completing the demo, you'll have the option to check out the content of the full version. 

Please enjoy the world of IGNISTONE!

notes.title: We will start delivering the information for IGNISTONE!
notes.notes:
Thank you for visiting this page.

As we approach the release on October 3rd, we will gradually provide you game information for IGNISTONE to enhance your enjoyment of the game!

We will provide informations such as character background stories, equipments and amulets, and some useful tips and tricks.

IGNISTONE is an authentic roguelike action game that can be easily enjoyed with simple controls. We're working hard to deliver an exciting game, so stay tuned and look forward to it!
